name: 01-baseline
text: The last train leaves at midnight, and I still have not packed.

name: 02-emotion-parameter
text: The last train leaves at midnight, and I still have not packed.

name: 03-emotion-markup
text: {angry}Look at what you have done.{/angry} {happy}But I forgive you.{/happy}

name: 04-sounds-and-pauses
text: I read the letter twice (sighs) and put it back in the drawer. <#1.5#> Then I picked up the phone.

name: 05-slow-and-low
text: Take your time. There is no hurry at all.

name: 06-turbo
text: Turbo costs 0.6 credits a character instead of one, and the difference is audible only on long narration.
